findings.problem: The hint does not rule out sich täuschen, which is also one common reflexive verb for being mistaken (Da täuschst du dich), so there are two right answers.
findings.fix: hint: mistaken; one reflexive verb, related to English err (not sich täuschen)

back.target: to be mistaken, to be wrong (reflexive)

note: The present forms include the reflexive pronoun, which is helpful, and the Perfekt is hat sich geirrt.
